sources.title: README.md · nvidia/Kimi-K3-NVFP4 at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Description: The NVIDIA Kimi-K3-NVFP4 model is the quantized version of Moonshot AI's Kimi-K3 model, which is an auto-regressive language model that uses an optimized transformer architecture. Kimi-K3 is a flagship, natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model designed for long-horizon coding, end-to-end knowledge work, game development, deep reasoning, and visual-agent use cases. sources.title: [Tracking] Kimi-K3-NVFP4 end-to-end kernel support #4568
sources.snippet: Goal Track end-to-end FlashInfer kernel support for nvidia/Kimi-K3-NVFP4 on B200/B300, with vLLM integration that does not require the checkpoint's compatibility patch. Kimi-K3 is a 93-layer hybrid model with 69 KDA layers, 24 MLA layers, Attention Residuals (AttnRes), Stable LatentMoE, and a multimodal vision tower.
